email.body1:
Nathan, saw Topia launch Horizon, your agentic AI platform for global mobility, on the back of the Bow River recap.

A new flagship platform usually means more in-market accounts than the team can cover before momentum fades, and that gap is where pipeline goes cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up on its own, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Topia off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Nathan, quick follow-up for Topia.

After a recap and a major launch, expectations on pipeline usually jump faster than headcount can. Most CROs don't actually know how many meetings they need to book to hit the new number, so the gap shows up late and becomes a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Topia needs to close that gap this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Nathan, last bit of proof for Topia.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Topia's reply rate likely compares to peer HR-tech firms. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?

Nathan, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to Topia's mobility motion? I'll tailor it to you either way.
